meaning: n. The back part of the leg between the knee and the ankle. / n. A young cow or bull.

n. The sharp curved nail on the toe of a bird or animal. / n. The part of a crab or lobster used for gripping The lobster grabbed the clam with its big claw and held it. / v. To scratch or dig with sharp nails. Our dog clawed at the back door so she could come into the house.
n. Two things of the same kind. / n. Two people who do things together.
